name: What are the signs of moisture issues in a basement that needs flooring?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of moisture issues in a basement that needs flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of moisture issues in a basement include a musty odor, visible mold or mildew on walls or existing flooring, efflorescence (white powdery residue) on concrete surfaces, peeling paint, or warped baseboards. You might also notice damp spots on the floor or walls, or condensation on pipes. Prior to installing new flooring, it's crucial to address these signs by identifying and resolving the source of the moisture, which could be anything from high humidity to leaks in the foundation or plumbing. A professional moisture test will confirm hidden issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for musty odors, mold, efflorescence, peeling paint, damp spots, or condensation. Address these signs and conduct a moisture test before flooring installation.
